lead: Congratulations. You opened me. Most people only get to open me once.
So. Let me explain. Slowly. You look like you need slowly.
I'm a book that can hold... special beings.
Big ones. Hairy ones. Ones with far too many teeth. Your people call them cryptids. Your people also call them fake.
They are not fake. They live in your woods, your lakes and your swamps. And right now, nobody is collecting them.
When nobody collects them, they start collecting people. That is bad. Mostly for the people.
So here is the deal. You find them. You beat them. I hold them. Everybody lives. Probably.
ask:
The little grey men left me with you, so now you work for me. Congratulations again.
First question: how do you plan to pay?

replies.say: I will bring you all of them.
replies.book: Everyone says all. I will count later. I always count later.
I just told you. A book. A special book. Do not make me do the whole thing again.
Noted. In pencil. Item 1 is in pen.

ask: Item {item}. It is warm. They are always warm the first time. How do you feel?

replies.book: Good answer. Do not tell the others.
They do that. It stops when I close.
Now we are talking. Well. I am. You are fetching.

ask: {down} is on the ground. Lying on the ground was not part of the deal.

replies.book: Say sorry to {down}. I only keep count.
Then the plan is also on the ground.
I can write it down. That is not nothing. Ask anyone I have written down.

recall.line: You said that was the plan. I kept the plan. It is on page one, lying down.

ask: Another one down. I am starting a list for this.

replies.book: Started. It has a title. The title is your name.
It is happening again right now. Get up.

ask: All of yours are down, and you are still standing. That is the wrong way around.

replies.book: Yes. That was never the question.
This was never about you. Remember what I said? They collect people. Go again.
Page one, line one, in red. You were holding me upside down.

ask: A fire. You sit. They rest. I watch the dark for you. Do not get used to it.

replies.book: Do not thank me. I write every thank-you down as money you owe.
I was made four hundred years ago. I am still waiting for my lunch break.

replies.say: What should I bring you next?
replies.book: Something heavy. My pages keep blowing about. Bring me a paperweight with teeth.

recall.line: You asked what I am. Here is one more thing: I am the reason the dark stays away from this fire.

ask: Tell me something true about yourself. I collect those too.

replies.book: Good. Scared people watch the trees. Brave people end up as pages in me.
Then I will be scared for both of us. Someone here should know what they are doing.
Then I will start with nothing. Most entries do.

recall.line: The first one looked at you, you said. They all do now. Sleep facing the fire.

ask: The line-up is asleep. One of them talks in it. Do you want to know what it says?

replies.book: It says your name, and then a number. I would not worry about the number.
Wise. I will tell you anyway when it matters, which will be the worst possible time.

ask: Where were you, before me?

replies.book: Home is still there. That is what the fetching is for.
Then you lost nothing by coming. Write that on a card and keep it in your shoe.

ask: An island fire. Keep it lit all night, the shop lady said. Did you get anything new to wear this year?

replies.book: Good. Wear them where the windows can see you. Something here checks.
Then sit close to the fire and close to me. I am leather. Leather counts, I think.

ask: The end of the trail. {mythic} is ahead, and it has heard about you. Not from me. Mostly.

replies.book: That you are always on time. Be on time.
Nobody is ready. Ready is a box people tick on a form.
You are home. It simply has a cryptid on the roof.

recall.line: {Where}, at a trail's end, you said you were ready. Ready goes stale, like bread. Let us check the date.

ask: Another trail's end. The air is wrong here. It is wrong on purpose.

replies.book: Then you are learning. Learning costs money. I am sending you the bill.
It is quiet. Quiet is the sound fine makes right before it stops being fine.

ask: {mythic} is beaten in {region}. The roads are open. I also have an empty page with its name on it. Hint, hint.

replies.say: I'll come back and bind it.
replies.book: Then the page waits. Pages are better at waiting than mythics.
Enough is what people say before they turn to page two.
It comes back with friends, and I have to make room. I hate making room.

recall.line: On the first page you said, and I quote, "{said}" Item {item} says otherwise.

ask: Two regions. My pages are warming up. I am not.

replies.book: I have all the time in the world. I just do not share it.
Your best is written in me. It is a short page.
Wings. There is a gap in the margin the shape of something that flies. Fill it.

recall.line: {Ago} you said this might not be for you. Here you are anyway. I said nothing then. I am saying it now.

ask: Three mythics. Somewhere, a door has fewer monsters behind it. What do you want as a reward?

replies.book: Nothing it is. I pay that right away. It is the only thing I ever pay.
One answer, then. The thumbprint on my pages is not mine. Books do not have thumbs. Ask again later.
You can rest when I close for good. I have never closed for good.

recall.line: {Nick}. You asked where the next one was before the first one stopped moving. I liked that. Do not tell anyone I said so.
{Where} you said catching one felt good. I stopped asking how you feel. It was weird for both of us.

ask: Four. People will hear about you now. Mostly the wrong people. Are you doing okay?

replies.book: Good. Stay that way. Most people I know did not.
Same. I have not felt well in four hundred years. Keep going.

ask: Item {item}. You are getting the hang of this. That is how it starts.

replies.book: The rest of it.

replies.say: I'm only doing what you asked.
replies.book: Everyone is. That is how the rest of it starts, too.

recall.line: {Where} you said the first one looked at you. This one did not. You did not notice. I did.

ask: Item {item}. The ink took it faster than the last. So did you.

replies.book: It is fast. From in here, fast and bad look the same.
Then we agree, which should worry one of us.

ask: Item {item}. Did you ever ask where they go when the page closes?

replies.book: Somewhere quieter than here. Not nicer. Quieter.
The smartest thing anyone has said during a binding.
replies.note: Does not want to know where they go.

recall.line: {Ago} you said you would rather not. Item {item}. Rather not was never no.
All of them, you said, like a kid who promises to clean their room. Item {item}. The room is still messy.

ask: My pages are heavier now. I mean really heavy. Lift with your knees.

replies.book: You will. I am not worried about you. I am worried about your back.
Nothing that goes into me comes back out. That is kind of the point.

ask: It broke free. My ink does not miss. It chose to leave. I did not.

replies.book: Its own. They get to choose. Once.
Tire it out first. Then try. Here is one more drop of ink for the next fight. Do not spill it.
I will write that it went. I will not write that you let it.

recall.line: {Ago} you wanted to let one go. Things you let go do not stay gone. It is behind you. Right now.

ask: The ink is drying on the page and not on the beast. Again.

replies.book: You are doing it too early. Tire it out, then try.
Everything here is. That is why it needs collecting.

ask: Three tries, nothing. I have seen this before, and I remember how it ended.

replies.book: With me on a shelf, and the beast in a town.
Then take this: a drop of the good ink, for the next one. I keep it for people who say that.

ask: Two losses in a row. I have a page just for this, and you are filling it in very neatly.

replies.book: Do it. Put the first one that fell on the bench. Let it watch the next one win.
Every bad run is just a bad run. Until it is the last one.
I am a book of counting. Counting is my whole job.

recall.line: You said I did not warn you. Consider yourself warned, in red, the right way up.

ask: Down again. Somewhere a door creaks every time you lose. I can hear it from here.

replies.book: The one they come out of when nobody is collecting.
The door does not give points for trying. It gives points for speed. Bring me something fast.

ask: The last stone before {mythic}. You can still turn around. I would not, but you can.

replies.book: Books do not do things. Doing things is your job.
We do. Take this drop of ink for {mythic}. Better to spend it there than on your page.
Turn around twice and you are facing it again. See? I saved you a walk.
replies.note: Thought of turning around at the last stone.

recall.line: At your first last stone you nearly turned around. You did not. That is the only reason there is a second one.

ask: Another last stone. They always put the worst at the end. Nobody has ever asked them to stop.

replies.book: The ones who make the trails. They never put the easy one last. I wrote to complain. They framed my letter.
That is the spirit. It is also the only exit.

ask: I have written you down as {nick}. In pencil, for now. Pencil means I like you.

replies.book: Ink is for the beasts. You are the help.
replies.note: Asked to be written in ink.

replies.book: It is. Very little here is fine. Enjoy the one thing.

recall.line: {Ago} you said you were not scared. I have been scared for both of us since. It is tiring. Take a shift.

ask: The fire is low. Something out there is counting your steps. It keeps losing count. Lucky.

replies.book: Not tonight. It counts worse in the dark.
Bold. I will write that down as your last words. In pencil. Just in case.

recall.line: {Where} you said you were at home before me. I checked. It is still there. A light was on.

ask: Ask me something. I feel like answering. That almost never happens.

replies.book: Yes.
You picked me up. Most people read the cover first.
Someone who asked the last question too. Go to sleep.

recall.line: {Ago} you said beating one was enough. The lake disagrees. It has a long memory.
{Where} you asked what happens if you don't. This is what happens. They talk to each other. The lake was listening.

ask: {mythic} goes back under the water. The lake hid it for a long time. It will stay mad at you even longer.

replies.book: Being mad is the lake's job. Catching is yours. Come back for it.
Everything in water comes back. That is what water is for. Bring me something with fists for when it does.

recall.line: {Where} you said you were scared. Out here there are no trees to watch. Watch the sky.
{Ago} you asked if I ever sleep. Out here I could. Nothing moves. That is exactly why I will not.

ask: {mythic}, beaten, in a desert that will not remember it happened. I will.

replies.book: Do not. I am not being kind. I am just keeping notes.
Because the desert forgets everything in the end. People too. Someone has to remember.

recall.line: At your first trail's end you asked to go home. You have stopped asking. I noticed. I did not write it down. Some things I keep.
{Where} you asked if I could do anything. I have been doing it ever since. You would not like the list. The bayou is on it.

ask: {mythic} is down in the water. The bayou does not take sides. Neither, it turns out, do I.

replies.book: My own. I have never once been on yours, and you are still alive. Think about that.

replies.say: I thought you were on mine.
replies.book: I am on the page. You are on the page. Draw your own conclusions, in pencil.

recall.line: {Ago} you asked, once, what I am. You have not asked since. You are right not to trust me. Keep it that way.
Every trail done. {Ago} you promised me all of them. All of them was never the trails.
{Ago} you asked to be written in ink. Look at the first page, {nick}. I went over it. It will not come off.

ask: {mythic}. The last of the trails. My pages do not end. They just get a new owner.

replies.book: Look down.
You are done with the trails. That is a different thing, and you will find out how different.
replies.note: Said they were done, in the Ozarks.

ask: A trail's end again. {mythic} has been told you are coming. It did not take the news well.

replies.say: Then let's not keep it waiting.
replies.book: Good. Mythics hate people who are on time. It is the only thing we have in common.
It can. It will spend the night getting bigger. Your choice.

recall.line: {Where} you said it was fine. It was not. You noticed afterwards. I noticed first.
{Ago} you asked what it had heard about you. Now they all hear about you. You are a rumor with a book.

ask: {down} is down. The list I started for this is on its second page now.

replies.book: They do. That is the thing about them. Do not make it the thing about you.
Long enough to need a ruler. Short enough to fix. Win something.

recall.line: {Ago} you said it would not happen again. I stopped correcting you. The list does it for me.
{Where} you said sorry. I kept it. Sorry is cheap, but I am a collector.

ask: Lost twice again. The door I told you about is open a crack. I can feel the cold air on my spine.

replies.book: Bind something. That is the only lock it has.
You will. It sounds like an empty page turning.

recall.line: {Ago} you asked me to stop counting. I did not. The count is too high, and it has your name on it.
{Where} you called it a bad run. It has been running ever since. It is fitter than you.

ask: Item {item}. I am getting thick. Not around the middle. Around the spine.

replies.book: I am proud of my pages. You are in them. Do the math.
Slow is how I ended up on a shelf last time. Do not.

recall.line: {Ago} you said you were only doing what I asked. I have asked for a lot since then. You have never said no.
{Where} you did not want to know where they go. You still have not asked. That is the closest thing to trust I get.

ask: Another fire. I have counted every one you lit. Do you want the number?

replies.book: No. It is the only number I am fond of, and I keep it.
Good. Numbers spoil by the fire. Like milk, and people.

recall.line: {Ago} you wanted to know what the sleeper says. It still says a number. The number has gone up.
{Where} you chose not to hear the sleeper. It has started saying it louder.
{Where} you told me nothing true about yourself. You have been telling me since, one fight at a time. You flinch left.
